title: Consumers of searchAllDashboardsThroughK8sRaw only need a small field subset
answers: Who consumes the results of searchAllDashboardsThroughK8sRaw?
Which DashboardHit fields does provisioning actually read?
Is it safe to drop a field from internal dashboard search results?
body: searchAllDashboardsThroughK8sRaw feeds exactly two private consumers: the provisioning reader, which uses manager, source, and legacy-ID fields, and a second consumer that only reads name, title, and folder. Neither reads labels or updatedBy, which is why those table-only fields could be dropped from the request without breaking callers. The single-page /api/search path is a separate code path and is unaffected by this request. Before removing/adding a field here, re-check both consumers since this function has no other callers.
applies: pkg/services/dashboards/service/dashboard_service.go internal search helpers feeding provisioning and dashboard listing consumers.
